title: Joint etale-local sections of coefficient-sized locally constant set sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme, with the equivalent coefficient-sized etale and pro-etale sites and inclusion i of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let H_a be a coefficient-sized family of set-valued sheaves on the pro-etale model. Suppose every H_a is locally constant: some family W_j covering the final object identifies each slice restriction with the constant sheaf of a coefficient-sized set Q_j [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Suppose also a pro-etale family U_j covering the final object has, for every j, a section of at least one H_a on U_j. Then there is a coefficient-sized family V_j of etale objects such that i(V_j) cover the final pro-etale object and every i(V_j) has a section of some H_a. No nonemptiness of the family, coefficient sets, or X is assumed.

source.place: Lemmas 5.1.1-5.1.4, pp. 33-34, and Proposition 6.8.4(6), final section-descent paragraph; family version by the coproduct/epimorphism argument

proof.text: Apply the coefficient-universe locally constant counit theorem separately to every H_a. Compose its invertible underlying counit with toSheafify for the pointwise left Kan extension of the etale restriction. The composite tau_a is locally surjective by Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_toSheafify and local surjectivity of isomorphisms.

Index L by triples (Y,a,s), with Y in the coefficient-sized etale model, a in K, and s a section of H_a at the image of Y. All three indices have the coefficient universe. Given a section on U_i, restrict it to any W mapping to U_i. The image sieve of tau_a at this restricted section is covering. Every arrow Z into W in this sieve has a Kan-extension representative t. The pointwise Kan cocone and Types.jointly_surjective_of_isColimit give an etale object Y, a map Z to its image, and a section of the etale restriction at Y. This section is definitionally a section of H_a at the image of Y. Thus the covering image sieve is contained in the pullback of Sieve.ofObjects of the constructed family.

For an arbitrary pro-etale object T, apply GrothendieckTopology.transitive to the given covering sieve Sieve.ofObjects U T and the pullback coverings just constructed. This proves CoversTop for the family of images of Y. Its sections are the third coordinates of the indices. No choice of an element of K is made except from hsec, so the empty-family and empty-base cases are handled by the same transitivity proof.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 5.1.1--5.1.4, p. 34; the remaining family argument uses local surjectivity of sheafification, pointwise Kan representatives, and transitivity of covering sieves

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientLocallyConstant_etaleSections (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : Type (max v (u + 1)))
    (H : K → Sheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
      (Type (max v (u + 1))))
    (hH : ∀ a : K, ∃ (L : Type (max v (u + 1)))
      (W : L → Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X),
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).CoversTop W ∧
        ∀ j : L, ∃ Q : Type (max v (u + 1)),
          Nonempty ((H a).over (W j) ≅
            (constantSheaf ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).over (W j))
              (Type (max v (u + 1)))).obj Q))
    (I : Type (max v (u + 1)))
    (U : I → Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (hU : (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).CoversTop U)
    (hsec : ∀ j : I, ∃ a : K, Nonempty ((H a).obj.obj (op (U j)))) :
    ∃ (L : Type (max v (u + 1)))
      (V : L → Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleSite.{u, v} X),
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).CoversTop
        (fun j ↦ (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).obj (V j)) ∧
      ∀ j : L, ∃ a : K, Nonempty ((H a).obj.obj
        (op ((Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).obj (V j))))
